summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun
details: The package's preinstall script (setup.mjs, obfuscator.io-style hex-named identifiers) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases at npm install time, unzips it into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against math_init.js shipped in the package root. math_init.js is a 727KB heavily obfuscated file using classic string-array-rotation obfuscation (a ~1500-entry mixed literal array plus a shuffler dispatcher and hex-named globals) whose content cannot be reconciled with the package's stated purpose (an auto-generated TypeScript API client). The result is that `npm install` of this package runs an opaque, attacker-authored payload under an alien runtime, bypassing Node-focused scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
